items.title: 14.4.1 Scalar Triple Product of Vectors (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle page par humne dekha tha ke 14.4 mein teen vectors ka ek naya product aa raha hai. Ab us ki baqaida definition seekhte hain. Is sabaq ke teen sawal hain: triple product kya hai, us ki kitni qismein hain, aur scalar triple product kaise likha aur parha jata hai. Yeh page chhota hai magar aage ke har page ki buniyaad yahi hai, is liye har line samajh kar aage barhiye.

Kitab shuru mein batati hai ke scalar triple product vector calculus ka ek aham (zaroori) concept hai jis ke bohat se shobon (fields) mein istemal hain. Teen dimensional space (lambai, chaurai, unchai wali duniya) mein yeh un shaklon ka volume nikalne mein bara kirdar ada karta hai jo teen vectors se banti hain, jaise parallelepiped (tirchha dabba) aur tetrahedron (teen-konay wala pyramid); yeh hum isi chapter mein aage seekhenge. Saath hi yeh coplanarity (ek plane mein hona) check karne ka bhi ek zabardast auzaar hai: is se pata chalta hai ke teen vectors ek hi plane mein hain ya nahin.
Kitab ke mutabiq vectors ke triple product ki do qismein hain:
Is section mein hum sirf scalar triple product parhenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Dono ke naam ka raaz aakhri operation mein chhupa hai. (a) mein aakhri kaam dot product hai, aur dot product ka jawab hamesha number hota hai; is liye yeh "scalar" triple product hai. (b) mein aakhri kaam cross product hai, jis ka jawab vector hota hai; is liye yeh "vector" triple product hai. Yaad rakhne ka aasan tareeqa: "aakhri nishaan dekho: dot to number, cross to vector." Vector triple product is section mein nahin hai, us ki fikr na karein.

Ab definition. Maan lijiye \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) teen non-zero vectors hain (yani koi bhi zero vector nahin). Inka scalar triple product in teeno mein se kisi bhi shakal mein likha jata hai:
Scalar triple product \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) ko chhota kar ke ek square bracket (box) mein bhi likhte hain:

blocks.text_alt: u dot (v cross w) equals the box product u v w

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is line mein product ko band bracket ke baghair chhapti hai: "u · (v × w". Sahi \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) hai, yani aakhir mein \()\) aayega. Choti si ghalti hai, magar exam mein bracket poora likhiye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Jawab number kyun hai? \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) ek vector hai. Phir \(\underline{u}\) aur us vector ka dot product liya, aur dot product hamesha number deta hai. Bas!
Kaam ki tarteeb pakki hai: pehle cross product, phir dot product. Kyun? Doosri tarteeb \((\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v})\times \underline{w}\) ka koi matlab hi nahin banta, kyun ke \(\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v}\) to number ban chuka, aur cross product ke liye do vectors chahiye, number aur vector nahin. Misaal: "5 cross \(\underline{w}\)" koi cheez nahin hoti.
Isi wajah se aksar bracket chhor dete hain: \(\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) ka hamesha matlab \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) hi hota hai, kyun ke doosra matlab mumkin hi nahin. Kitab Examples 24 aur 25 mein yahi chhota tareeqa istemal karti hai, to ghabraiye ga nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Definition ki teeno shaklen ghaur se dekhiye: \(\underline{u} \to \underline{v} \to \underline{w} \to \underline{u}\) ek daaire (circle) mein ghoomte hain. Har shakal pichli shakal mein letters ko ek jagah aage ghuma kar banti hai, jaise ghari ki suiyan. Isay cyclic order (gardishi tarteeb) kehte hain. Teeno ka jawab bilkul ek hi number hota hai; kyun, yeh hum 14.4.2 mein volume se aur 14.4.4 mein determinant se saabit karenge.
Lekin agar aap do vectors ki jagah badal dein (cyclic order tor dein) to sign badal jata hai, kyun ke cross product mein \(\underline{w}\times \underline{v} = -(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) hota hai:
\[\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{w}\times \underline{v}) = -\,\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\]
Box notation \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) mein vectors usi tarteeb se likhe jate hain jis tarteeb se woh \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) mein aate hain: pehla dot wala, phir cross ke do.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Chaliye ek chhota sa hisaab kar ke dekhte hain (yeh hamara sawal hai, kitab ka nahin; components wala tareeqa 14.4.4 mein tafseel se aayega). Maan lijiye \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + \underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = \underline{i} + \underline{k}\).
Pehle cross product:
\[\underline{v}\times \underline{w} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= \underline{i}(1 - 0) - \underline{j}(0 - 1) + \underline{k}(0 - 1)\]
\[= \underline{i} + \underline{j} - \underline{k}\]
Ab dot product: \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = (1)(1) + (1)(1) + (0)(-1) = 2\).
Dekhiye, jawab sirf ek number 2 hai, koi \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) nahin. Yahi "scalar" ka matlab hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Upar wali misaal mein \([\underline{u}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{v}]\) kitna hoga? Pehle khud sochiye, poora hisaab dobara mat kijiye.
Jawab: \(-2\). Kyun ke \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) ki jagah badalne se cyclic order toot gaya, aur sirf sign ulta hota hai, number wahi rehta hai. Aur \([\underline{v}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{u}]\)? Yeh cyclic shakal hai, is liye jawab \(2\) hi rahega.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Triple product do qisam ke: scalar \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) (jawab number) aur vector \(\underline{u}\times(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) (jawab vector).
2. Scalar triple product mein pehle \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\), phir \(\underline{u}\) ke saath dot.
3. Notation: \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\).
4. Cyclic shaklen barabar: \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = \underline{v}\cdot(\underline{w}\times \underline{u}) = \underline{w}\cdot(\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\).
5. Do vectors ki jagah badlo to sirf sign badalta hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Pehle dot product kar lena: \((\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v})\times \underline{w}\) bemaani (bekaar) hai. Hamesha pehle cross.
2. Jawab ko vector bana kar likhna, jaise \(2\underline{k}\). Scalar triple product ka jawab sirf number hai.
3. Vectors ki tarteeb laparwahi se badal dena. \([\underline{u}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{v}]\) aur \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) barabar nahin, ek doosre ke negative hain. Bachne ka tareeqa: sawal mein di gayi tarteeb hi determinant mein rakhiye.
4. Kitab ki tarah bracket adhoora chhor dena; exam mein \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\) poora likhiye.
